title.narrative: TZ Business Environment, Growth and Innovation: PE BEGIN

description.narrative: The objective of this programme is to support national efforts to improve the business environment, in line with Tanzanias Blueprint for Regulatory Reforms. It is centered on three main outputs, based on the Blueprint Action Plan: (i) Regulatory framework is improved; (ii) The assessment scheme for policy and regulatory reforms is improved; and (iii) Capacity of ICT infrastructure, including related systems, for business related services is enhanced.
